A Vandel has{br}apparently attacked Mirei Forest{page}Village and broken its "Sealing Ring"...{page}Know of these rings, {hero}?{br}They lie across the Twin Islands,{br}shaped like those our two ancient{page}"Silver Goddess Statues" hold. Its silver glow{br}turned gold, as did all the land{br}around it. An eerie sight...{page}Our four Village Chiefs met at once.{br}We decoded the old lore and found{br}how to mend the rings. We{page}followed it, and the ring shone silver{br}again. The land, too, was restored...{close}

Be{br}sure to remember it! "Holy Silver,{page}Horey, Horey", eh?{close}
